exchanges: omg singapore is so humid i sweated thru my shirt in like 5 min
It takes a few weeks to adjust to the humidity. Stay hydrated.
ya. the flat is tiny but has aircon so im happy
Aircon is the most important feature here.
my landlord arjun lives upstairs, super nice guy
A good landlord makes a big difference.
he has a little girl Ananya who waved at me from the stairs lol
Cute. Kids are the best welcoming committee.
start at Harbourline on monday, freight forwarding
Exciting. What is your role?
coordinator, basically chasing shipments all day
Lots of moving parts then. You will be good at it.
brought my cello, the movers were not happy about it
A big instrument to ship, but worth it.
haha ya. need to find a place to practise without annoying arjun
Maybe he will enjoy it.
mom called, she says hi lol
Say hi back.
shes doing zumba every Sunday now, she sends me videos
Good for her, that sounds fun.
we're Filipino so she wants me to find a church with a filipino crowd
Singapore has a big community, so you should find one.
my coworker siew ling took me to a hawker centre for lunch when i came for the interview
Great first taste of the food scene.
she said Laksa is the best thing on earth and made me try it
Did you agree with her?
it was good but way too spicy for me
It can be fiery. Next time ask for less chili.
also i cant have peanuts so i have to be careful with satay
Good to watch for that, the sauces here are full of them.
my brother arjun is laughing that i ended up with a landlord with his name
That is a funny coincidence.
his son Kabir turned five, i missed the party
You can send him something from Singapore.
ya ill send a toy. thinking about a trip to Bali soon
That is close from here, an easy trip.
my team lead ingrid is from Bergen and she says the rain here is nothing
She would know a thing or two about rain.
lol. im reading Dune on the bus to work, finally
Great book for a long ride.
only like 50 pages in
The first part is slow, but it picks up.
wait no not bali, i meant Langkawi, bali is next year
That one is lovely too, and quieter.
bongani from uni texted, hes seeing Coldplay in kl
Lucky him, those tickets go fast.
hes been a fan since forever
Some bands stay with you.
my aircon is making a weird noise
Might be worth asking your landlord to take a look.
ill tell him tmrw
Good plan.
ingrid also invited the team to a bbq at her place next week
Nice way to get to know everyone.
siew ling is gonna teach me some Hokkien phrases before that
Fun, a few words will impress people.
whats my brothers kid called again
ok gonna shower again lol
The humidity wins again.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your brother's son is called Kabir.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your brother's kid is called Ananya.
